title: bromus madritensis var. rigidus
intro: Bromus madritensis var. rigidus, commonly known as Rigid Brome, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rigid Brome include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions like arthritis and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rigid Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
